markets.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 0.7% in December 2026, as reported to one decimal place, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Please note: the Expiration Value is the single-decimal value published at the Source Agency.
